create_lighton_ocr_processor: create a LightOnOcrProcessor instance with image_processor, tokenizer, patch_size, and spatial_merge_size parameters
call_processor_with_images_and_text: call the LightOnOcrProcessor to process images and text, replacing image tokens with expanded token sequences
compute_image_tokens_from_size: compute the number of image tokens given an image size and patch size using _num_image_tokens
get_resize_output_image_size: get the target image dimensions after resizing to fit within a longest edge constraint and patch size alignment
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image sizes using _get_num_multimodal_tokens
